def test_section_one_largest_doses():
        """Doses above a full shift at the ceiling level, up to the largest section 1 allows (2,880 minutes at
        115.0 dBA): dose is linear in reading minutes, so each is a whole multiple of the sealed ceiling-level
        worker (480 minutes at 115.0 dBA on a 480-minute shift)."""
        sealed = load("ceiling_level")[0]
        base = next(r for r in sealed["report"]["workers"] if r["id"] == "A2")
        assert sealed["survey"]["workers"][1]["log"] == [[480, 115.0]] and base["dose"] == 102400.0
        cases = [  # id, shift, log, multiple, TWA offset in dB when the multiple is a power of two
            ("X4", 480, [[960, 115.0], [960, 115.0]], 4, 6.0),
            ("X3", 1440, [[1080, 115.0]], 3, None),
            ("X6", 60, [[1440, 115.0], [1440, 115.0]], 6, None),
        ]
        survey = {"survey": "HC4-MAX", "workers": [
            {"id": wid, "group": f"M{wid}", "shift_minutes": shift, "log": log, "peaks": []} for wid, shift, log, _k, _o in cases]}
        within_limits(survey)
        report = reduce(survey)
        assert isinstance(report, dict) and len(report["workers"]) == 3 and len(report["groups"]) == 3, f"largest doses: {report!r}"
        groups = sorted(cases, key=lambda case: f"M{case[0]}")  # groups come in ascending code order
        assert [g.get("group") for g in report["groups"]] == [f"M{case[0]}" for case in groups], f"largest doses groups: {report['groups']!r}"
        by_code = {g["group"]: g for g in report["groups"]}
        for (wid, _shift, _log, k, offset), row in zip(cases, report["workers"]):
            group = by_code[f"M{wid}"]
            for where, got, keys in ((f"worker {wid}", row, ROW_KEYS), (f"group M{wid}", group, GROUP_KEYS)):
                assert isinstance(got, dict) and set(got) >= keys, f"largest doses {where}: {got!r}"
>               _number(got["dose"], k * base["dose"], f"largest doses {where} dose")
